-- Step 1: Create indexes (run once)
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_keyword_keyword ON keyword (keyword);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_company_name_name_gin ON company_name USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops);

-- Step 2: Run the optimized query
SELECT MIN(cn.name) AS from_company,
       MIN(lt.link) AS movie_link_type,
       MIN(t.title) AS non_polish_sequel_movie
FROM title AS t
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON t.id = mk.movie_id
JOIN keyword AS k ON mk.keyword_id = k.id
JOIN movie_link AS ml ON t.id = ml.movie_id
JOIN link_type AS lt ON ml.link_type_id = lt.id
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON t.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN company_name AS cn ON mc.company_id = cn.id
JOIN company_type AS ct ON mc.company_type_id = ct.id
WHERE t.production_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2000
  AND k.keyword = 'sequel'
  AND lt.link LIKE '%follow%'
  AND mc.note IS NULL
  AND ct.kind = 'production companies'
  AND cn.country_code != '[pl]'
  AND (cn.name LIKE '%Film%' OR cn.name LIKE '%Warner%');
